async def _expect_code(awaitable: Any, rpc_code: int, data_code: str | None) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(JsonRpcError) as exc:
        await awaitable
    assert exc.value.code == rpc_code
    if data_code is not None:
        assert exc.value.data is not None
        assert exc.value.data["code"] == data_code


async def test_signoff_commits_and_excludes_proposer(pg_pool: Any, env: Env) -> None:
    req = await _propose(pg_pool, env, env.member, "shipped")

    # The proposer is a team member who can see the request but may not sign.
    await _expect_code(_sign_in(pg_pool, env, env.member, req.request_id), -32602, "signoff_not_allowed")
    assert await _stage(pg_pool, env) == "review"

    out = await _sign_in(pg_pool, env, env.admin, req.request_id)
    assert isinstance(out, MindmapWorkflowSignoffOutput)
    assert out.committed is True
    assert out.signed_count == 1
    assert out.signoff_min == 1
    assert out.node_id == env.node
    assert await _stage(pg_pool, env) == "shipped"
    assert await _req_status(pg_pool, env, req.request_id) == "committed"

    await _expect_code(_sign_in(pg_pool, env, env.owner, req.request_id), -32602, "signoff_complete")


async def test_signoff_needs_min_distinct_signatories(pg_pool: Any, env: Env) -> None:
    req = await _propose(pg_pool, env, env.member, "dropped")  # signoff_min = 2
    first = await _sign_in(pg_pool, env, env.owner, req.request_id)
    assert isinstance(first, MindmapWorkflowSignoffOutput)
    assert first.committed is False
    assert first.signed_count == 1
    assert first.signoff_min == 2
    assert await _stage(pg_pool, env) == "review"
    assert await _req_status(pg_pool, env, req.request_id) == "pending"

    await _expect_code(
        _sign_in(pg_pool, env, env.owner, req.request_id), -32602, "signoff_already_signed"
    )
    assert await _stage(pg_pool, env) == "review"

    second = await _sign_in(pg_pool, env, env.admin, req.request_id)
    assert isinstance(second, MindmapWorkflowSignoffOutput)
    assert second.committed is True
    assert second.signed_count == 2
    assert await _stage(pg_pool, env) == "dropped"
    assert await _req_status(pg_pool, env, req.request_id) == "committed"


async def test_signoff_excludes_assignee_from_count(pg_pool: Any, env: Env) -> None:
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, env.owner) as conn:
        await conn.execute(
            "UPDATE work_items SET assignee_id = $1 WHERE memory_id = $2 AND tenant_id = $3",
            env.admin,
            env.node,
            env.owner,
        )
    req = await _propose(pg_pool, env, env.member, "dropped")
    await _expect_code(_sign_in(pg_pool, env, env.admin, req.request_id), -32602, "signoff_not_allowed")
    out = await _sign_in(pg_pool, env, env.owner, req.request_id)
    assert isinstance(out, MindmapWorkflowSignoffOutput)
    assert out.signed_count == 1
    assert out.committed is False
    assert await _stage(pg_pool, env) == "review"


async def test_signoff_roles_restriction_and_owner_proposer(pg_pool: Any, env: Env) -> None:
    req = await _propose(pg_pool, env, env.owner, "archived")  # signoff_roles = (admin,)
    # Proposer (owner) excluded even though the role would otherwise be permitted to write.
    await _expect_code(_sign_in(pg_pool, env, env.owner, req.request_id), -32602, "signoff_not_allowed")
    # A plain member has write access but not the required role.
    await _expect_code(_sign_in(pg_pool, env, env.member, req.request_id), -32602, "signoff_not_allowed")
    assert await _stage(pg_pool, env) == "review"
    out = await _sign_in(pg_pool, env, env.admin, req.request_id)
    assert isinstance(out, MindmapWorkflowSignoffOutput)
    assert out.committed is True
    assert await _stage(pg_pool, env) == "archived"


async def test_cancel_proposer_admin_and_denied(pg_pool: Any, env: Env) -> None:
    tool = MindmapWorkflowCancelMoveTool()

    def inp(r: WorkflowSignoffRequest) -> MindmapWorkflowCancelMoveInput:
        return MindmapWorkflowCancelMoveInput(request_id=r.request_id, team_id=env.team)

    # A plain member who is not the proposer is denied by the permission check.
    owned = await _propose(pg_pool, env, env.owner, "shipped")
    await _expect_code(tool(_ctx(pg_pool, env.member, env.client_id), inp(owned)), -32603, None)
    assert await _req_status(pg_pool, env, owned.request_id) == "pending"

    # Team admin may cancel someone else's request.
    out = await tool(_ctx(pg_pool, env.admin, env.client_id), inp(owned))
    assert isinstance(out, MindmapWorkflowCancelMoveOutput)
    assert out.cancelled is True
    assert await _req_status(pg_pool, env, owned.request_id) == "cancelled"
    assert await _stage(pg_pool, env) == "review"

    # No longer pending.
    await _expect_code(
        tool(_ctx(pg_pool, env.admin, env.client_id), inp(owned)), -32602, "signoff_complete"
    )

    # The proposer (a plain member) may cancel their own request.
    mine = await _propose(pg_pool, env, env.member, "shipped")
    own = await tool(_ctx(pg_pool, env.member, env.client_id), inp(mine))
    assert isinstance(own, MindmapWorkflowCancelMoveOutput)
    assert own.cancelled is True
    assert await _req_status(pg_pool, env, mine.request_id) == "cancelled"
